toggle.title: Dangerous tier — Run any command
toggle.description: Selecting this tier in the matrix above is not enough — you must arm the main switch here. Turning it off immediately drops «Run any command» from all roles.
toggle.warning: This feature allows running any shell command on the server with the service user's privileges. There is no allowlist — the only safeguard is your personal, character-by-character review of each command before pressing Execute. A single wrong or unauthorized command can corrupt data or take the server down.
toggle.ackLabel: I understand this grants full shell access to the server and I accept full responsibility
toggle.disableButton: Main switch off (drops tier from all roles)
toggle.notGeneralMode: Requires the owner's role to be set to «Run any command» in the matrix above.
toggle.blocked_is_platform: Arming unavailable in platform mode — the environment voids the human-review guarantee.
